snippet_primary: "I spent thousands on bud vases that took a month to receive the first batch and another month to receive the second with correct design. DO NOT BUY from LiteSkyscraperStyle!!! His shop says United States but I think he's from London (at least that's what support told me). The shipment came from China. Design was NOTHING like we agreed on the first batch causing the seller to send me a second batch. The packaging was subpar. 20 broken vases in the first batch and 30 in the second. Seller refused to refund me for the broken ones."
subject_exact: buyer's complaint about damaged, misrepresented items from an Etsy seller and unresolved refund for broken units
